meta.title: HT Media × Pentonic: Hindustan Fresh on Campus 2026

slides.heading: Hindustan Fresh on Campus 2026
slides.lead: Empowering student expression and driving direct trials across 25 premier colleges in the Hindi heartland.

slides.heading: Engaging Gen Z across key campuses
slides.body: Pentonic seeks to evaluate three core campus integrations under Hindustan Fresh on Campus 2026: a UGC aspirational wall, an experiential kiosk for discounted sales managed by Pentonic sales reps, and 40 half-page Hindustan editorial recaps. The objective is to drive brand equity, physical trials, and regional buzz.
slides.aside: The client requires a modular evaluation and scope breakdown for each component to finalize campaign investment by today EOD.

slides.heading: Write Your Tomorrow with Pentonic
slides.lead: Connecting student ambition with tactile product experience across North India's biggest college fresher festival.
slides.imageAlt: College students smiling and gathered around a colorful campus festival arena in Delhi NCR, holding pens and notebooks enthusiastically.

cards.title: Pentonic Wall Integration
cards.body: Large-format interactive aspirational walls where freshers write career dreams and startup ambitions using Pentonic pens.

cards.title: Pentonic Branded Kiosk
cards.body: Dedicated branded engagement and sales zone offering product discovery, guided trial, and discounted student bundle packs.

cards.title: Hindustan Editorials
cards.body: 40 half-page editorial photo features across regional Hindustan city editions capturing on-ground student energy.

slides.heading: Interactive aspirational UGC wall
slides.body: Positioned at prime campus entry zones, the 'Write Your Aspirations' installation invites students to pen their ambition directly onto a branded canvas using Pentonic pens. Emcees drive active participation, and the top five most inspiring student quotes per campus are shortlisted for social curation and regional editorial coverage.
slides.imageAlt: Indian college students writing their career goals with sleek black Pentonic pens on a large branded aspirations wall at a campus fest.

slides.heading: Direct trials and campus sales hub
slides.body: HT provides dedicated space and premium stall setup across 25 colleges, while Pentonic's sales team manages retail execution and sampling. Freshers test the full portfolio, including Ball, Gel, and GRT lines, with exclusive student exam bundles and discounted packs driving direct on-ground conversion and long-term brand adoption.
slides.imageAlt: Young Indian college students testing smooth gel pens at a bright modern Pentonic stationery booth on an active university quad.

slides.heading: 40 half-page print photo recaps
slides.body: Hindustan delivers high-credibility regional storytelling across key Hindi heartland city editions. Forty half-page editorial recaps will document the campus excitement, showcase student talent, and feature the Pentonic Wall activations. This extensive print coverage builds immense regional trust and lasting recall.
slides.aside: Reaching millions of households across Delhi NCR, UP, Bihar, and Jharkhand through trusted vernacular journalism.

steps.title: Phase 1: Alignment
steps.body: Finalize college roster approvals, kiosk designs, wall branding, and editorial schedule with Pentonic marketing.

steps.title: Phase 2: Campus Blitz
steps.body: Deploy Pentonic Wall Integration and Pentonic Branded Kiosk across 25 campuses during freshers events.

steps.title: Phase 3: Print Recaps
steps.body: Publish 40 half-page Hindustan Editorials across target city editions highlighting student moments.

steps.title: Phase 4: Synthesis
steps.body: Deliver post-campaign audit, proof-of-performance photos, sales tally review, and editorial clipping dossier.

slides.heading: Commercial evaluation and rollout
slides.body: To meet the client EOD evaluation timeline, HT's pricing team is preparing itemized cost sheets for the Pentonic Wall Integration, Pentonic Branded Kiosk fabrication, and 40 half-page Hindustan Editorials. Upon confirmation of the preferred scope mix, college permissions and production schedules will be locked immediately.
slides.aside: Detailed itemized commercials are shared separately by HT's commercial pricing team.
